style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the one picture is a golden satin ribbon (the value bar): golden satin keys in the ribbon's own family, a rose-pink Enter as the joyful treat of the same world, butter soft keys, a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.why: Description 'until only one is left in common' / Look 'a filled strip down the right' / Stage 'The value bar ... a strip of fixed length filled to the amount of the fraction on the current rung': a fixed length measured to an amount is a satin ribbon (IMAGES.md section 3, a length). One skin for the value bar on every rung and for the scratch bars; the equal cuts, the fill and the guide line are drawn in code over it.
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.
